mechanism_claims.claim_text: Induced mcsS expression in E. coli MDS42 directly inhibits growth and reduces viable cell counts; this supports direct toxic antibacterial activity in the expression system, not a purified-peptide MIC.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Microcin S encoded by mcsS in pAZ15

mechanism_claims.limitations: construct-expression assay; no purified peptide dose-response or MIC endpoint in local source

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Full-length mcsI protects EPEC E2348/69 from MccS-producing strains in the adherence assay, supporting mcsI as the self-immunity determinant.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: mcsI immunity gene in the Microcin S operon
direct_assay_types: genetic immunity/rescue assay in EPEC adherence model
mechanism_claims.limitations: immunity phenotype is assayed through the adherence model, not a biochemical receptor assay

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Microcin S is classified by the source as a class IIa microcin/bacteriocin with a probable leader peptide, double-glycine cleavage context, and cysteines possibly involved in disulfide formation.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Microcin S precursor and gene cluster
mechanism_claims.limitations: classification/sequence context; not promoted to a separate direct killing mechanism beyond growth/CFU and immunity assays
